ui.export.title: Export
ui.export.toFolder: Writes the selected tables to {dir} in the project folder (the folder is created if missing).
ui.export.toDownload: Downloads the selected tables (a ZIP file if there are several files).
ui.export.includesUnsaved: Unsaved changes are included in the output.
ui.export.hasErrors: Nothing was exported because there are {count} validation errors. Fix the errors and export again.
ui.export.cannotForce: Names that cannot be exported as Protocol Buffers block the export even when forced. Rename them or choose another format.
ui.export.empty: There are no tables to export (tables with load errors cannot be exported)
ui.export.writeFailedTitle: Some files could not be written
ui.export.protobufHint: Writes a schema (.proto) and the data (.pb) for each table.
ui.export.versionHint: Only records whose version column is at most this version (e.g. 1.2.3) are exported (records with an empty version are always exported). Leave it empty to export all records.
ui.export.versionInvalid: Enter a semantic version such as 1.2.3
